summary: Iteration 9 - Regions CRUD, Per-Contract Payments, Reference Source Enhancement: 18/18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working: Settings page with 9 tabs including new 'Regionlar' tab. Companies modal with Region select dropdown, enhanced Reference source with conditional fields (Şirkət/Şəxs/Media/Digər), Contact position as select dropdown, and per-contract payment system in Ödəniş tab.

seed_data_creation: Test regions and companies created and cleaned up during tests. Default regions in DB: Bakı, Sumqayıt, Gəncə, Lənkəran, Mingəçevir, Şəki, Şirvan, Naxçıvan, Abşeron, Digər.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page now has 9 tabs including new Regionlar tab. Companies modal has enhanced features: 1) Region is now a Select dropdown populated from Settings/Regionlar, 2) Reference source (Referans mənbəsi) has 4 options (Şirkət, Şəxs, Media, Digər) with conditional fields - Şirkət shows company selector + representative fields, Şəxs shows name/surname/position, Media/Digər shows note input, 3) Contact position (Əlaqədar şəxs tab) is now a Select dropdown with positions from Settings, 4) Ödəniş tab shows per-contract payment sections with Ümumi yekun summary. All backend APIs working correctly. /api/options/all returns regions array and updated reference_sources.

regions_crud.details: GET /api/settings/regions returns default regions. POST creates new region. DELETE removes region. Created regions appear in /api/options/all.

regions_tab_ui.details: Settings page has Regionlar tab (7th tab). Shows region name input, submit button, and list of regions with delete buttons. Toast 'Region əlavə edildi' on successful add.

region_select_in_company.details: Companies modal Şirkət tab has Region as Select dropdown populated from /api/options/all regions.

reference_source_enhancement.details: Reference source dropdown has 4 options: Şirkət (shows company select + Nümayəndə adı/soyadı/vəzifəsi), Şəxs (shows Ad/Soyad/Vəzifə), Media/Digər (shows Referans qeydi note input).

contact_position_select.details: Əlaqədar şəxs tab has Vəzifə as Select dropdown with positions from Settings (Direktor, Təsisçi, Baş direktor, etc.).

per_contract_payments.details: Ödəniş tab shows per-contract payment sections (Müqavilə 1, Müqavilə 2, etc.) each with Ümumi məbləğ, Ödənilən, Qalıq borc fields. 'Ümumi yekun' summary card shows grand totals.
